text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—A hotel with high soundproofing, in a 
quiet location, and a short distance from 
the training grounds, correct? Do you have 
any other requests?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate it if I could choose a 
buckwheat hull pillow. Though it's peak 
season, so if that's impossible—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I've picked out a few 
candidates, so I'll send them over by 
email.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please let me know once you've decided on 
your preferred hotel. I'll make the 
arrangements right away.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion! Calstone Light O, 
here!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome. Right O, your rental 
application for the expedition equipment 
has been accepted.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, the date, time, and intended race 
were left blank. I'm here to confirm those 
details with you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's the Aoi Stakes in May!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Understood. That completes the procedures 
for both of you. Please wait to hear from 
us.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Are you traveling for an away race too, 
Believe? Where to?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'm at Kyoto too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Could it be the Aoi Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No. I... I can't run in the Aoi Stakes. 
Because I lost yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Are you not feeling well? Truth be 
told, I'm not in great shape either.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Her acceleration isn't building up as well 
as before. She's on a losing streak in 
mock races, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Still... they seem relaxed, or 
rather, completely normal.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! I didn't mean it in a weird 
way...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
True, she's on a losing streak right now. 
However, if we can win the Aoi Stakes, 
there won't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer told me they would make me win. 
That they'd figure out a way for me to 
come out on top.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I just aim for maximum speed. 
I can keep my focus entirely on that."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: So that's why... she doesn't waver...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No. ...That is true.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Stay true to the path I've set out on. 
That's the only thing I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, you look a bit down. Is 
something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While reviewing Calstone Light O's mock 
race in the VR Umalator, Godolphin Barb 
called out to me.
choice_data_list:
Actually, I'm conflicted on our strategy 
for the Aoi Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Could it have something to do with that 
mock race we watched earlier?"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Umamusume are approaching the 3rd 
corner! Calstone Light O, who's in the 
lead, drifts wide! The trailing pack is 
closing the gap!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner and into the 
straight! Here comes Durandal from the 
back! With a razor-sharp late burst, she 
blows right past them all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Calstone Light O hasn't been able 
to win in either the Umulator simulation 
races or the mock races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, winning the Aoi Stakes is 
in jeopardy.
choice_data_list: I'm being held back by that assignment...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"You mean what we talked about the other 
day—cornering, race development, and all 
that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
However, didn't you claim that all 
problems could be overcome with sheer 
speed?
choice_data_list:
I haven't been able to build up that much 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We had already established a long-term 
training plan. So for this stage, her rate 
of growth could be considered right on 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it's still not fast enough to 
overcome the challenge. Whether we can 
reach sufficient speed by the Aoi Stakes 
or not...
choice_data_list:
I can't say for certain that speed alone 
will be enough to win...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To increase our win rate, should we spend 
the remaining time addressing challenges 
like cornering?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I promised to lead Calstone Light O to 
victory. That's why, while aiming for top 
speed, I want to show her a path that 
guarantees a win.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she'll need one more push to 
truly, fully believe in the possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about something like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Setting the races you'd like to run, you 
mean?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's nice to do that once in a while, 
isn't it? What kind of race would you like 
to compete in, Right-O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Anything is fine?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Of course. With the Umulator, you can 
customize the settings however you like.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A cheetah!! I want to run with a cheetah!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Understood, a cheetah, right? Anything 
else?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, because we're free.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Then kangaroo, lion, gazelle, giraffe, 
ostrich, and jaguar too, please!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: What course?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: On the straight!!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. How is this?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!! There really is a cheetah here!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
There aren't any gates, but that's the 
starting line. Don't worry, the animals 
are controlled to make sure they run 
straight.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to think I can race against the 
fastest animal, a cheetah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy! So happy! I'm so happy I 
just wanna dance! Hyah-hoy, wah-hoy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Animals are lined up side by side on a 
turf course created in virtual space. It 
seems we're really going to race like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And then, I noticed a single Umamusume 
mixed in among the animals.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume who set a world record 
in the 1,000 meters. It seems this was all 
orchestrated by Godolphin Barb.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Here we go! On your mark, get set――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah! ...What?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, the cheetah pulled 
away, sprinting gracefully into the 
distance. Before long, its silhouette had 
vanished.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... The cheetah really is fast...! 
However...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I won't let go!! OOOOOOHHH! I can still 
see the tip of that tail!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a sudden surge!! Calstone Light O 
accelerates. The force of her grip on the 
ground propels her body forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her accelerating body felt as if it 
floated lightly into the air. In that 
split second, she closed the gap on the 
cheetah at a gliding speed. She's hit top 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her strides across the turf steadily 
quicken their tempo, accelerating even 
further. This is—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes... It's here, it's here! 
I've got you in my sights, Cheetah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O finally closed in on the 
cheetah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A cheetah's top speed is 110 km/h. Even if 
it can only sprint full-tilt for about 300 
meters, to close down that advantage...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I can do it, I can do it! I've still got 
more in me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A roar to spur oneself on. As if in 
response, the sound of hoofbeats rings out 
loudly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUUUUMBLE!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My heart beats faster, as if in resonance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her flowing jet-black hair soon forms a 
single straight line, and her very form 
transforms into a single black arrow."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: I've caught up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, Calstone Light O and the 
cheetah were running neck and neck.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: From here on out!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
100 meters remaining—normally, she would 
be decelerating here. Her energy should be 
practically spent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... she pulled it together. 
Channeling her desire to run at peak 
speed— faster than anything else—into pure 
power.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaargh!! I am! Going to beat! A 
cheeeeeeetah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The black arrow pierced through, leaving 
the cheetah far behind. Yet, a new shadow 
galloped even faster than the arrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of the distance, Calstone Light O 
doesn't notice. However, as if sensing 
something—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
More... even more! Beyond that light!! 
HAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her leg turnover and arm swings grew even 
faster. Forward, even a millimeter 
forward! Her whole body screams it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Nwaaaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I stood frozen in utter shock...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O—won. Against the fastest 
land animal, the cheetah. And drew 
neck-and-neck with the world's fastest 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting that truth sink in once more, I 
realized something. This was the exact 
same feeling I had the very first time I 
saw her run...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you see that? I actually beat 
a cheetah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was astonished by her incredible speed, 
and my heart fluttered with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The boundless potential hidden within her. 
I want to see... where it will lead.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
! Yes. Hearing you say that directly is 
kind of embarrassing, though.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, I want to become even faster. 
Fast enough to surpass even a cheetah's 
top speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's an absurdly ambitious goal, sure. But 
if I keep pushing my speed to the absolute 
limit, maybe I'll reach it one day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O even made me think that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it looks like you've made up your 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I'll be wishing you the best of luck from 
here as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. The final mock race 
before the Aoi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer. How should we run today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A glittering roster of front-line 
competitors gathered for the spring graded 
stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To lead Calstone Light O to victory. The 
instructions to give are—
choice_data_list: Give it everything and run for top speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry about cornering, stamina 
pacing, or race developments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to reach top speed. With that 
desire alone, she can deliver her greatest 
run.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wait... What is that?! That's not a 
strategy at all. People are going to 
question your leadership, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I believe. In Calstone Light O's speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Observing Student A
text_block_list.text:
So fast...! No way, she is an Umamusume, 
right? Can anyone really get that fast?!

text_block_list.name: Observing Student B
text_block_list.text: Ehh, amazing, amazing! So fast! So cool!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want everyone to feel it too. 
The thrill of discovering just how fast 
one can become.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And I want you to see it. Her running, 
faster and more beautiful than anything 
else—"
